summary: Authorization failures in private deployment after edge proxy upgrade — tenant assertion header truncated
description: Customer LedgerSafe reported that multiple service accounts and admin users started receiving 401/403 errors immediately after an edge-proxy upgrade rolled in their private VPC. Symptoms point to tenant assertion (X-Redwood-Tenant) being truncated by the ingress path, which removes the tenant_id claim used by RBAC to resolve tenant-scoped roles. Issue began coincident with a proxy version bump (edge-proxy v2.14.0) applied during a maintenance window.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Log in to LedgerSafe private console behind their private VPC identity proxy
2) Trigger an admin API call that requires tenant-scoped admin role (e.g., /v1/admin/tenants/{tenant_id}/users),
3) Observe 403 with message 'tenant not found' or 401 for service tokens that previously worked
4) Capture HTTP request headers at ingress and at upstream identity proxy to compare X-Redwood-Tenant header length
observed_logs: edge-proxy[03/10/2026T14:12:11Z] WARN request: dropped header 'X-Redwood-Tenant' (size 8196 -> truncated)
idp-proxy[03/10/2026T14:12:12Z] ERROR authorization: missing tenant claim after header parsing
api-gateway[03/10/2026T14:12:13Z] INFO auth: resolved principal=service-account:payment-relay but tenant=null -> returning 403
comments: 2026-03-10 14:30 - Support (Aisha): Initial triage - customer reports broad 403s for tenant-scoped APIs after edge-proxy upgrade. Asked for header dumps and example request IDs.
2026-03-10 15:05 - Customer (LedgerSafe SRE, Raj): Provided packet capture and header snapshot. Attached evidence showing X-Redwood-Tenant value cut off mid-UUID.

2026-03-10 16:10 - SRE (Marc): Confirmed edge-proxy change log includes default buffer limit reduction for header handling in v2.14.0. Hypothesis: header truncation introduced by new default (8KB) plus proxy sidecar behavior.

2026-03-11 09:23 - Engineering (Nora): Reproduced locally with edge-proxy v2.14.0 using long tenant assertions (SAML->base64) in header; observed truncation. Filed PR to make header-size configurable and to fallback to chunked body POST for very large assertions.

2026-03-12 11:02 - Support (Aisha): Customer applied temporary workaround (set idp-proxy to pass assertion in request body via POST) and reported immediate reduction in 403s. Customer requests timeline for stable fix and rollback guidance.

2026-03-12 12:00 - Customer (Raj): "We need a permanent fix; our assertions are intentionally large because they contain tenant-scoped entitlements. Rolling back the proxy isn't ideal during business hours."
investigation_notes: Edge-proxy v2.14.0 introduced a stricter header buffer policy to mitigate header-smuggling attacks. Default effectively limits individual header processing to ~8KB which cuts base64-encoded SAML assertions used by some private IdPs.
LedgerSafe's IdP sends a base64 SAML assertion serialized into X-Redwood-Tenant for downstream RBAC mapping. When truncated, downstream auth flow treats tenant as absent leading to RBAC failures.
Reproduction steps executed in staging show identical truncation behavior when header length > 8KB. Older proxy versions (v2.12.x) do not truncate.
Temporary mitigation verified: configuring idp-proxy to POST assertion payload in body or reduce assertion size eliminates truncation and restores access.

Risk analysis: Changing global edge-proxy header buffer has security rationale; blanket increasing limit could reintroduce attack surface. Prefer targeted configuration per-tenant or switch to body-based assertion passing.
Monitoring: Add alert for spike in 'missing tenant claim' log entries and an automated runbook link to this ticket.
resolution: WORKAROUND (applied 2026-03-12): LedgerSafe and Support agreed to patch their idp-proxy to POST large assertions in the request body instead of using the X-Redwood-Tenant header. This restored access for impacted endpoints within 30 minutes.

PROPOSED FIX (in progress): Engineering to backport configurable header buffer support to edge-proxy and add an allowlist for known internal headers used for tenant assertion. PR #582 submitted; needs security review and canary rollout plan.

ROLLBACK OPTION: If customer cannot change their idp-proxy, ops can rollback edge-proxy to v2.12.x in their private cluster. This is higher-risk and requires maintenance window consent from the customer.
FOLLOW-UPS: Update Private deployment docs to recommend sending large assertions in request body or using signed compressed JWTs with shorter encoded size. Create postmortem after stable fix release.
